response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth with 20 years of development experience and solid credentials in developer tools and testing infrastructure. However, he critically lacks the minimum requirement of 2+ years of people management experience, which is non-negotiable for this full-time people-leadership role. His entire employment history consists of individual contributor positions (Senior/Staff level) with no evidence of managing direct reports, conducting performance reviews, or leading teams. While his mentoring and knowledge-sharing abilities are valuable, they do not substitute for formal management experience required to set priorities, establish performance expectations, and develop team members.
strengths: Extensive 20-year technical background with proven expertise in testing infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and developer tools (Fluent-Asserts, Trial frameworks, TDD practices)
Strong system design and architecture knowledge demonstrated through microservices infrastructure, high-performance real-time systems, and experience handling millions of concurrent requests
Demonstrated ability to teach and influence through workshops, online courses, open-source contributions, and community-building activities (Refactoring Dojos, Code Katas)
concerns: No demonstrated people management experience—all roles are individual contributor positions with no evidence of managing direct reports, performance reviews, or formal team leadership
Limited recent mobile platform expertise; most mobile work was 8+ years ago (WatchUp 2015-2016); current focus is full-stack/backend rather than mobile platform ecosystem

No clear evidence of leading organizational change or driving strategic initiatives at team/organizational level; experience is primarily technical contribution-focused rather than strategic leadership

key_factors.factor: Exceeds technical and developer tools requirements
